QuestInfo.name: This Moustache Comes Fully Loaded
QuestInfo.0: Spiegelmann has one last request for you in his quest for beautification.
QuestInfo.1: Spiegelmann needs something to take his moustache to the next level. Go to the Mine Depths to defeat Cart Bears get their Channeling Jewels.
QuestInfo.2: Spiegelmann now has a fully tricked out moustache... but it looks pretty much exactly like it always did.

0.0: Now that the old fanny duster is under control, it needs a finishing touch. Sparkles.

yes.0: A little touch of Channeling Jewel Powder would bring a luster to my 'stache that could blind every starstruck onlook for a hundred miles! You gotta go into the Mine Depths and bring me Channeling Jewels from Cart Bears. Twenty is plenty.

no.0: Come ON! What is it with you and not seeing things through?
